d: India is expanding its long-range strike capabilities with new missiles and kamikaze drones capable of hitting targets up to 1,000 kilometres away, strengthening its deterrence following Operation Sindoor and lessons from the US-Iran conflict. Meanwhile, India's E20 ethanol-blended petrol rollout is fueling debate over engine compatibility, mileage and consumer rights. This episode separates myths from facts while exploring the real challenges behind India's ethanol mission and its push for greater energy security. Hem Kaur Saroya tells you more on Firstpost.
